name: qkd_astk_er_tap-e2-COMMIT
purpose: ECTLA-2 2026-10-17 (coordinator 0co (3): in->out combinational e-read REJECTED): qkd_astk_er_tap re-designed with a pin register on EVERY input and output (read_v/read_addr/eso_v/esi in, aso/response/fault out); no input reaches an output. Read latency TAP_RL = ERL 3 + 4 = 7 edges (request +2: read pin flop + aso pin flop; response +2: esi pin flop + response pin flop), written to kv_static_join_plan.md for KVJ-E to price in the PV calendar. Lockstep-exact vs qkd_astk_native_er_service_w with the request delayed 2 and the response delayed 2 (tb_qkd_astk_er_tap, 20k cycles, both fault laws at +2); same 979 pins, faces, outline. Inline leaf of the wires-only ASTK strip successor qkd_astk_strip_er_s (8 x so[12:0] out, 8 x so[0] in, 8 x si[632:569] in, 4 read ports, 4 responses).
